issues.desc: background.md uses paper section shorthand §1/§3/§5/§6/§7 (e.g. "pre-reg §1 arms", "§3 fixed-point injection", "§7 metric names") without ever stating these are sections of the Proofbound/Lattice paper. A standalone reader who is new to the project cannot infer what §1, §3, §5, §6, §7 denote without prior project context.

background.md references multiple cross-story IDs inline (B-2d4c / B-ebbb / B-f248 / B-7036 as "infra-(a)" components; B-e67f as the corpus story) without a one-sentence description of what each referenced story delivered. Per Dimension 2, cross-story references require at least a one-sentence context on first appearance so the background is independently readable.
